newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures rise late in active trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures rise late in active trade.

text.p: April 22 - U.S. debt futures rose late, with June T-bonds rallying to 108-05/32 in active trade. Several bond traders attributed the gains to rumors of a budget agreement. This morning, Senate's Lott told one wire service that he informed the White House and Republican negotiators he must know Wednesday morning if a budget deal is possible.
